title: "02.eda"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(fpp3)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
crash_ts <- read.csv("../data/nyc_daily_crashes.csv") |>
  mutate(day = as.Date(day)) |>       # text back to date
  as_tsibble(index = day)             # back to a time series
```

## Daily Crashes

```{r}
crash_ts |> 
  autoplot(crashes) +
  labs(title = "NYC Daily Mot Vehicle Collisions", y="Crashes per Day", x=NULL)
```

## Weekly Seasonality
```{r}
crash_ts |>
  filter_index("2023-01-01" ~ "2024-12-31") |>
  gg_season(crashes, period = "week") +
  labs(title = "Weekly pattern in daily crashes (2023–2024)", y = "Crashes per day", x = NULL)
```

## Annual Seasonality
```{r}
crash_ts |>
  gg_season(crashes, period = "year") +
  labs(title = "Annual pattern in daily crashes by year", y = "Crashes per day", x = NULL)
```

## Severity: injuries and deaths
```{r}
crash_ts |>
  index_by(week = yearweek(day)) |>
  summarise(injured = sum(injured), killed = sum(killed)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(injured, killed), names_to = "severity", values_to = "people") |>
  autoplot(people) +
  facet_grid(severity ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Weekly people injured and killed", y = "People", x = NULL)
```

## Road user: who gets injured

```{r}
crash_ts |>
  index_by(week = yearweek(day)) |>
  summarise(Pedestrians = sum(ped_injured),
            Cyclists    = sum(cyc_injured),
            Motorists   = sum(mot_injured)) |>
  pivot_longer(-week, names_to = "road_user", values_to = "injured") |>
  autoplot(injured) +
  facet_grid(road_user ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Weekly injuries by road user", y = "People injured", x = NULL)
```
